title: Industrial Kinematic Trajectory Model (IKTM): Coordinate-Free Autoregressive Generator
abstract: arXiv:2609.22173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mobility simulation supports logistics, safety, and communications planning in industrial environments such as ports, mines, and airports. Existing trajectory models, however, rely on absolute coordinates, road-network tokens, or semantic zones: representations that are site-specific and not well suited to unstructured industrial terrain. We introduce the Industrial Kinematic Trajectory Model (IKTM), a coordinate-free trajectory generator that represents industrial vehicle motion through kinematic sequences (speed and heading change) with no absolute spatial reference. IKTM uses an autoregressive causal transformer with probabilistic mixture heads and extends our prior coordinate-free Markovian model with deep sequence modelling and an explicit duration-conditioning signal. Trained on one site and evaluated zero-shot on three unseen sites, it matches the small-turn shape of the empirical turn-rate distributions of held-out telematics; ac

translated_title: 工业运动学轨迹模型：无坐标自回归生成器
translated_abstract: 移动性仿真支持港口、矿山、机场等工业环境中的物流、安全和通信规划。然而，现有的轨迹模型依赖于绝对坐标、路网标记或语义区域——这些表示方式是特定于场地的，并不适合非结构化的工业地形。我们提出了工业运动学轨迹模型，这是一种无坐标的轨迹生成器，通过运动学序列（速度和航向变化）来表示工业车辆的运动，无需任何绝对空间参考。IKTM 采用带有概率混合头的自回归因果 Transformer，并通过深度序列建模和显式的持续时间条件信号，扩展了我们先前的无坐标马尔可夫模型。该模型在一个场地训练，并在三个未见过的场地上进行零样本评估，其结果与留出的远程信息数据中经验转弯率分布的小转弯形状相匹配……
tldr: IKTM 是一种无坐标的自回归轨迹生成器，通过速度和航向变化的运动学序列表示工业车辆运动，仅在一个场地训练即可在多个未见过的场地上实现零样本泛化，并匹配经验转弯率分布。
en_tdlr: IKTM is a coordinate-free autoregressive trajectory generator that represents industrial vehicle motion through kinematic sequences of speed and heading change, achieving zero-shot generalization across unseen sites and matching empirical turn-rate distributions.
